name: liquid-logo
blurb: Logo animates with flowing liquid distortion and refraction effects.
description: Renders an image with WebGL-based liquid morphing effects including ripple distortion, refraction, and edge blur that evolve continuously.
use_when: Brand logos or images that need organic, fluid motion without jarring animation.
avoid_when: Low-performance devices or server-side rendering — WebGL is GPU-intensive. May be invisible in headless contexts.
a11y: Image is rendered as WebGL texture; no alt text or semantic equivalent available.
